sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages twenty-two to twenty-eight, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: signal distances, three-point-turn sight distances, passing clearances, vehicle widths and following-distance seconds are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: physical page twenty-four is the turning-diagram page and extracted only as diagram captions and car letters, so the drawn turning paths were not read and no fact was taken from that page; the motorcycle text on physical page twenty-eight continues past the section range mid-sentence onto the next chapter page and was used only up to its last complete sentence (verify — sec04-D-FLAG).
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Turning diagrams (physical p24): only captions and car letters extract as text; the drawn lane paths for two-way and one-way turns are not recorded; render the page to read them
